objective.name: classify_screenshot.py
objective.purpose: Classify a PNG screenshot as VALID (rendered content) or BLACK (no-signal readback). Stdlib-only histogram analysis: counts pixels whose max(R,G,B) exceeds a threshold, divides by total, compares to a minimum fraction. Built to distinguish valid Android-emulator renders from all-zero captures produced by certain GPU modes. Requires a PNG path argument (no no-arg default — errors without one).
objective.side_effects: Read-only. Reads the PNG, prints a one-line verdict (or JSON). No file writes. Exit codes: 0=VALID, 10=BLACK, 2=error.
objective.language_packages: stdlib only (struct, zlib, json, argparse, sys) — PNG decoder is hand-rolled (no Pillow/numpy)
path_assumptions: Expects a PNG path as the first positional arg; cwd-relative or absolute

switches.effect: Channel value above which a pixel counts as 'lit' (guards against near-black noise)
Minimum lit fraction to classify VALID (rejects stray non-zero artifacts)
Emit a JSON object with all metrics instead of the one-liner

objective.required_arguments: One positional: the PNG file path
objective.explicit_env_checks: false — no environment dependencies; classification thresholds are explicit CLI parameters

subjective.usual_invocation: Invoked by the GPU-sweep harness to auto-verdict each captured frame; occasionally run by a developer to spot-check whether a screenshot is a real render or a black readback.
subjective.invocation_change_recommendation: None. Clean positional+flags CLI. No verb form, no 'python3 < file' pattern.
subjective.linux_changes_needed: None. Fully portable stdlib (struct/zlib PNG decode). Runs unchanged in an Ubuntu container — in fact preferable on Linux/CI where Pillow may be absent.

macos_dependency.notes: No macOS dependency; deliberately avoids sips/Pillow.

subjective.typical_runtime: Sub-second per image (zlib inflate + one linear histogram pass).
subjective.rewrite_language_recommendation: No. The hand-rolled stdlib PNG decoder is the whole point (zero-dependency portability for CI). A Pillow rewrite would add a heavy dependency for no functional gain.
subjective.merge_recommendation: Likely a single consumer today (GPU sweep), but keep standalone: it is a clean reusable verdict CLI and a natural building block for other visual-validation tests. Do not fold into the sweep script.
subjective.rename_recommendation: Optional/low value. Internal tool invoked by path; dropping .py buys little.
subjective.relocate_recommendation: Defensible to move under scripts/experiments/ or tests/experiments/gpu-sweep/ since it is purpose-built for that domain; weigh against keeping general visual utilities together in scripts/.
subjective.improvement_suggestions: Add unit tests (synthesize a black PNG and a lit PNG in-memory, assert verdicts/exit codes — trivial and high-value for a function other tests gate on). Consider a --batch mode to classify many files in one process and avoid per-image interpreter startup.
subjective.requirements_check_completeness: explicit and complete (thresholds parameterized; OSError/ValueError/zlib.error handled → stderr + exit 2); no environment requirements to check.
subjective.external_dependency_breakdown: Scoring policy (v1.0): +1 per env var; +1 per non-standard / separately-installed program (xcrun/simctl, Android SDK tools, maestro, grpcurl, psql, gmtool, node/npm, lnav, etc.); programs shipped with macOS (ps, lsof, top, pgrep, sysctl, open, pbcopy, curl, osascript, system_profiler, git, grep/sed/awk) are NOT counted; +5 if a simulator/emulator is required on the primary path; +10 per large non-default app required (Xcode, Android Studio/SDK, Genymotion, Postgres, brew). Here: env 0 + programs 0 (no subprocess) + sim 0 + apps 0 = 0.
subjective.change_score_rationale: Weights (v1.0): Linux portability full-block +8 / partial +4 / portable 0; other dimensions +1 (or +2 where noted). Linux portable 0. No tests (very testable, and it gates other tests) +1. Total 1.
subjective.quality_score_rationale: Anchored rubric (v1.0), sub-scores sum to 100 — Error-handling/robustness /25: 18; Tests /20: 0 (no self-tests); Structure/clarity /20: 17; Documentation /15: 13; Portability + explicit requirement checks /20: 20. Total 68. Clean zero-dependency hand-rolled PNG decoder with full filter support, explicit threshold/min-frac params, and proper exit codes; fully portable. Only the missing (and easy) test suite holds it back.
